solution_title: Multi-Day Trip Itinerary Planner, Hotels & Time Zone Hub
summary: Shared architecture blueprint for the Multi-Day Trip Itinerary Planner, Hotels & Time Zone Hub across all 8 web stacks. Pre-seeds Tokyo on load with live Places API (New) discovery results (attractions, restaurants, hotels), a live Time Zone API destination clock and UTC offset hub, Day 1 and Day 2 itinerary tabs with numbered day-colored AdvancedMarkerElement pins, multi-stop route polylines and waypoint optimization via the Routes API, and an embedded Street View preview panel (StreetViewPanorama + StreetViewService). Pure client stacks use Maps JS importLibrary() (Place, PlaceAutocompleteElement, Route.computeRoutes, AdvancedMarkerElement, StreetViewPanorama) and Time Zone REST with graceful Place.utcOffsetMinutes fallback; full-stack stacks (Next.js, FastAPI, Node.js Express) additionally route Places, Routes, and Time Zone calls through secure 127.0.0.1 BFF proxy endpoints with explicit X-Goog-Api-Key and X-Goog-FieldMask headers.
gmp_products_used: Maps JavaScript API (2D Vector Map, AdvancedMarkerElement, PinElement, Polyline, InfoWindow, StreetViewPanorama, StreetViewService)
Places API (New) (Place.searchByText, Place.searchNearby, PlaceAutocompleteElement, Place.fetchFields, Places Photo Media)
Street View Static / Maps JS Street View Service (StreetViewService.getPanorama & StreetViewPanorama)
ui_layout_summary: Two-column responsive split-screen workspace beneath a full-width top header bar. Top Header (64px): App title, destination PlaceAutocompleteElement search bar (data-testid="destination-search-input"), quick destination selector (data-testid="destination-quick-select"), and live Time Zone Hub pill (data-testid="timezone-hub") displaying destination local time, timeZoneName, and UTC offset. Left Sidebar (420px fixed on desktop, scrollable): split into (1) Day 1 / Day 2 itinerary switcher tabs (data-testid="itinerary-day-tabs") with day-color badges (Day 1 Teal #0F766E, Day 2 Amber #D97706), travel mode selector (DRIVE/WALK/TRANSIT, data-testid="travel-mode-select"), Optimize Order button (data-testid="optimize-route-btn"), route summary bar (data-testid="route-summary-bar"), and numbered itinerary stops list (data-testid="itinerary-stops-list"); and (2) Place Discovery section with Attractions / Restaurants / Hotels category tabs (data-testid="discovery-category-tabs") and live Places API (New) cards (data-testid="discovery-results-list") showing live photo, rating, review count, regularOpeningHours weekday summary, Add to Day 1/2 buttons, and Inspect Street View button. Right Workspace (flex-1): Primary interactive 2D Google Map (data-testid="map-container", min-height 520px, mapId="DEMO_MAP_ID", internalUsageAttributionIds=["gmp_git_agentsamples_v1.0.0"]) rendering numbered day-colored AdvancedMarkerElement pins and active-day Routes API polyline, paired with a docked Street View preview panel (data-testid="street-view-panel", height 240px) below/beside the map showing the live StreetViewPanorama for the currently selected hotel or landmark.

backend_proxy_endpoints.purpose: Search top-rated attractions, restaurants, hotels, and destination landmarks via Places API (New) Text Search with server-side X-Goog-Api-Key and explicit X-Goog-FieldMask.
Discover nearby hotels, restaurants, and attractions around the active destination or selected landmark via Places API (New) Nearby Search.
Fetch rich Place Details (viewport, opening hours, rating, photos) for a selected Place ID using Places API (New).

backend_proxy_endpoints.field_mask: N/A (media endpoint returning JSON photoUri via skipHttpRedirect=true or proxied image bytes)
backend_proxy_endpoints.purpose: Resolve and proxy Places API (New) photo media URLs without exposing the server API key in image src attributes.
Compute multi-stop day routes, leg durations/distances, encoded polylines, and optional optimizeWaypointOrder stop reordering via Routes API v2.
Fetch destination IANA time zone ID, localized time zone name, raw UTC offset, and DST offset from the Time Zone API for live destination clock calculation.
